items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Reed, of course, was -- he was also in and out of the theater at that particular group.

ctx.x: Well, one girl I remember was Alma Travis, and I think Lillian Randolph, who I mentioned earlier also, who was a dear friend of mine. And let me see, who else
that I can remember right now? Offhand -- Leonard Reed, of course, was -- he was also in and out of the theater at that particular group. But I can't remember any of the other names right now.
When you got to Los Angeles in 1935, who were the people that were playing music here? Who were the people that you remember that had bands and were performing?
